title: Term, effective and expiry months derive; expiry is month-end
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view customers (and edit customers to add or change a record), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open an asset page and its Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes). The asset card is on the left; the Compliance section sits below Contact.
  3. The record form open ("+ Add record" on a compliance service).
custom_steps:
1. Enter any two of term / effective month / expiry month and check the third derives.
  2. Type a month that conflicts with a derived one and see which wins.
  3. Try to Save with the term but neither date; then Save with a term and one date.
  4. Read where the expiry falls within the month.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Term, effective month and expiry month derive from one another (any two give the third); dates are months not days, a certificate always expires on the last day of its expiry month (not the last working day), and a typed month wins over a derived one.
  • A record needs the term and at least one of the two dates; it cannot be saved with neither.
  • A certificate that arrives already months old (issued by another shop) has its effective date entered manually.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10565 (S8, Compliance inspection records on the asset); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S8; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R10: “Term, effective month and expiry month derive from one another: any two give the third. Certificate dates are months, never days, and a certificate always expires on the last day of its expiry month. A month a person typed always wins over a derived one”
  • S8-R11: “A record needs the term and at least one of the two dates. It cannot be saved with neither”
  • S8-E2: “A certificate expires on the last day of its expiry month, not the last working day”
  • S8-E1: “A certificate arrives already months old, issued by another shop. The effective date is entered manually”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
